mapper.select: select a.*, CONCAT(b.list_nm ,'(',a.SEND_KEY,')') AS sender, c.img_nm, c.img_org_nm, c.img_url, c.kko_img_url from tblmi_kko_at_tmpl AS a INNER JOIN tblmi_set_lst AS b ON a.SEND_KEY = b.LIST_VAL AND b.use_yn ='Y' LEFT JOIN tblmi_cont_img AS c ON a.IMG_SEQ = c.SEQ where a.seq = #{seq}

select a.*, CONCAT(b.list_nm ,'(',a.SEND_KEY,')') AS sender, c.img_nm, c.img_org_nm, c.img_url, c.kko_img_url, e.CD_DESC AS cate_cd_desc, e.CD_SN AS cate_cd_sn, d.CD_VAL AS cate_sub_cd_val, d.CD_DESC AS cate_sub_cd_desc, d.CD_SN AS cate_sub_cd_sn, f.cd_val AS msg_tp, f.cd_desc AS msg_tp_nm, g.cd_val AS emp_tp, g.cd_desc AS emp_tp_nm from tblmi_kko_at_tmpl AS a INNER JOIN tblmi_set_lst AS b ON a.SEND_KEY = b.LIST_VAL AND b.use_yn ='Y' LEFT JOIN tblmi_cont_img AS c ON a.IMG_SEQ = c.SEQ LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS d ON d.CD_ID = 'CATE_SUB' AND d.cd_val = a.CATE_CD LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS e ON e.CD_ID = 'CATE' AND e.cd_sn = d.par_nm LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS f ON f.CD_ID = 'MSG_TP' AND a.tmpl_msg_tp = f.cd_val LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS g ON g.CD_ID = 'EMP_TP' AND a.TMPL_EMPSIZE_TP = g.cd_val where a.seq = #{seq}
